title: Hinomori Shizuku — Excited Unboxing♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Show Venue - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does everybody have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all set.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The staff's got theirs too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then...
Let's begin the after party for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hand on. Why don't we have Minori lead for us since it was her big moment today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree! Especially since you gave us such a lovely speech during the show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind taking the lead here, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like it if you did as well.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Pleeease!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! All of you?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Ahem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Today marks an auspicious occasion...
Uhh... I could not be more pleased to see that our solo show went so well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is starting to sound like one of those matchmaking interviews...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's pleased.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's very cute and very Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... We couldn't have done this without any of you! We were able to give the fans an incredible show because of all your help!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Quit stammering!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! S-Sorry, I can't help it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Anyway, thank you very much for all your hard work! And so, here's to a successful show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... How was it? Did I do okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it was a cute speech.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about heckling you, but I did manage to get a few good laughs...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice speech, Minori.
So, cheers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'd like to thank the staff again for all your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We really appreciate it.
So, please enjoy these sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: What...?! Th-Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Uhh... I'm so glad that I got to help out in the first MMJ solo show! It was really fun! I promise to keep supporting all of you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you for your kind words! We promise to do our best to keep bringing you fun shows like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for helping us put on this event as well, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was thanks to your planning and instruction that the staff were able to carry out what they needed to do. We couldn't have done it without you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku...?!
I-I'm not worthy! I mean... I'm so honored!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: P-Please, allow me to thank you all as well...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank us?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes! You probably remember how we ran into a bit of trouble during the fan event the other day because of my lack of foresight when it came to setup and carrying things...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Fortunately, all of that went smoothly this time.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I really appreciate how all of you took the time to discuss all of that with us beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This experience has meant quite a lot to me. So, thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to be so formal. Also, I didn't come up with everything that I told you just now. We had the help of some of our idol seniors.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Would you be willing to thank them for me as well...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. If it's okay with you that is. Right, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I know the show just ended... But since we're on the subject, was there anything in particular that gave you trouble this time around?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh... I'd probably say that it would've been nice to have a few more on board as staff... Can you guys think of anything else besides that?

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Oh, towards the beginning, we had a little trouble in terms of communication when it came to assigning roles.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I thought this one person was also selling merch with me, and I ended up telling them about how we're running low on some stuff without realizing that they were a guide... That seemed to confuse them a lot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
It probably didn't help that all the staff were all wearing the same T-shirts.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Come to think of it, a lot of people were asking people who weren't guides for directions.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's only natural. I mean, from their point of view, we're all the same staff...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right... Numbers and assignments... We'll have to keep those points in mind for the future.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Oh, about our roles... What if we had armbands that say what we've been assigned to do...?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
We sold wristbands today too.
What if they were color-coded?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can use Airi's color for people selling merch! I bet they'd feel better knowing you're on their side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that's your reasoning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, how about either Minori or Haruka's color for the guides? I'm not sure how I'd feel about Team Shizuku giving others directions...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-It's true that I don't have the best sense of direction, but my color's done nothing wrong...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're willing to admit the first part of that...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They're all smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (On top of that, they're providing us with suggestions regarding how to make our next one better.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's like we get to walk forward hand-in-hand with all those who support us...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That must be what MORE MORE JUMP! is truly about.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you're all very hungry too, MORE MORE JUMP! Please, have some of these sandwiches with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
